conferences.title: Unifying Adult and Pediatric Domains: Multi-Dataset Deep Learning for Fracture Classification, Detection, and Segmentation
conferences.authors: Md Saib Hossain, Md Maynul Hossen, Iffat Nur, Md Ashraful Islam, Shahariar Sarkar, Tasmin Sanjida, Azizur Rahman Anik
conferences.description: Systematic multi-task deep learning framework harmonizing adult (FracAtlas: 4,083 multi-anatomical X-rays, 717 fracture-positive, 922 instances) and pediatric (GRAZPEDWRI-DX: 20,327 wrist X-rays) label spaces into a unified input stream. Benchmark results: ResNet-50 binary classification via two-stage pseudo-labeling achieved 0.824 F1-score, 81.3% accuracy, and 0.930 ROC-AUC (+3.8% AUC gain); YOLOv11 led object detection with 0.550 mAP@0.5 and 0.230 mAP@0.5:0.95, outperforming Faster R-CNN (0.480) and YOLOv8s (0.431); DeepLabV3 (ResNet-101) led semantic segmentation with 0.512 mask mAP@0.5. Multi-dataset cross-domain learning effectively eliminated false positives on pediatric growth plates and resolved narrow fracture under-segmentation, advancing demographic-invariant musculoskeletal foundation models.

conferences.title: BanglaSign-Tutor: An Interactive Bangla Sign Language Learning System via Finger-Guided Feedback
conferences.authors: Md Saib Hossain, Md Shakil Hossain, Md Rakibul Islam, Abusaleh Alam Khan, Radwanul Islam Nayeem, Mst. Sumia Khatun, Md. Shafqat Talukder, Fahim Hafiz
conferences.description: First multimodal Bangla Sign Language (BdSL) interactive tutoring platform integrating computer vision, tactile haptics, and generative LLMs. Extracts scale-invariant 3D hand landmarks categorized by a Random Forest model on BDSL47 (47,000 images, 47 classes), achieving 98.20% accuracy for 37 Bangla alphabets (0.91 F1-score) and 99.50% for numerals (0–9). Features real-time visual finger pose error correction in Bangla, paired with Raspberry Pi 4-driven haptic vibration signals (200ms positive pulse vs. 800ms corrective pattern) for deaf-blind accessibility. Integrated Gemma 3 (4B parameter) via Ollama for dynamic, progressive 3–4 word sentence practice (e.g., 'আমি ভাত খাই'). A 16-participant user study validated a 56.43% overall reduction in learning latency (average time dropping from 26.46s to 11.53s), proving accelerated skill acquisition.

conferences.title: Urban Sustainability in Bangladesh: Satellite-Based Analysis of Land Use and Air Pollution Trends
conferences.authors: Md Saib Hossain, Md Maynul Hossen, Shahariar Sarkar, Tasmin Sanjida, Iftekharul Abedeen
conferences.description: Geospatial big-data framework on Google Earth Engine (GEE) analyzing multi-temporal Sentinel-2 MSI surface reflectance (10–20m resolution) and Sentinel-5P TROPOMI Level-3 tropospheric data from 2019 to 2025 across Dhaka (1,471 km²), Khulna (3,566 km²), and Rajshahi (2,420 km²). Extracted spectral indices (NDVI, NDBI, NDWI) and benchmarked six supervised ML models: Random Forest achieved leading Overall Accuracy of 99.0% (Dhaka), 99.3% (Khulna), and 99.1% (Rajshahi) with Kappa coefficients >0.988, followed by CART and XGBoost. Spatiotemporal analysis revealed Dhaka's built-up area expanded by +50% and barren land by +18.9% with vegetation (-5.5%) and water (-5.0%) declines, while Khulna suffered a -35.2% wetland loss and a +118% surge in SO2 post-2023. Correlated LULC shifts with atmospheric pollutants (NO2, SO2, CO, O3, CH4) to provide critical empirical evidence for UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDG 6, 11, 13, 15).
